verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs show it runs inference through llama.cpp and Apple MLX engines (MLX being Apple-specific acceleration) and supports GPU offload via `lms load --gpu`. A community report mentions a CUDA acceleration setting, implying NVIDIA support, but another user wishes it worked better on AMD Radeon. That AMD comment is a wish, not a concrete failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm/Vulkan or other vendor-specific kernels, evidence of runtime/engine selection per GPU vendor, and hands-on corroboration of good non-Apple GPU performance.
